lessons.title: Having finished the exam...
lessons.title_uz: Participle clauses: -ing, V3 va Having + V3
lessons.goal_uz: Ikki gapni bitta qisqa va ravon gapga birlashtirasiz: Built in 1428, the observatory... / Having finished, she left. Writing'da Grammatical Range 7+ uchun.

steps.title: The observatory of Ulugh Beg
steps.text: Built in the late 1420s, Ulugh Beg's observatory in Samarkand was one of the finest in the medieval world. Its founder, the grandson of Amir Temur, was not only a ruler but also a renowned scientist. Having studied mathematics and astronomy from an early age, he was determined to measure the sky more precisely than anyone before him. Working with a team of talented astronomers, he compiled a catalogue listing more than a thousand stars and calculated the length of the year with remarkable accuracy. After Ulugh Beg was murdered in 1449, the observatory was destroyed and gradually forgotten. Rediscovered in 1908 by the archaeologist Vasily Vyatkin, its remains now attract visitors from all over the world, reminding them of a scientific legacy that shaped astronomy for centuries.
steps.uz: 1420-yillarning oxirida qurilgan Samarqanddagi Ulug'bek rasadxonasi o'rta asrlardagi eng zo'rlaridan biri edi. Uning asoschisi — Amir Temurning nevarasi — nafaqat hukmdor, balki taniqli olim ham edi. Yoshligidan matematika va astronomiyani o'rgangan Ulug'bek osmonni o'zidan oldingi har kimdan aniqroq o'lchashga qat'iy qaror qilgan edi. Iqtidorli astronomlar jamoasi bilan ishlab, u mingdan ortiq yulduzni o'z ichiga olgan katalog tuzdi va yil uzunligini ajoyib aniqlikda hisobladi. 1449-yilda Ulug'bek o'ldirilgach, rasadxona vayron qilindi va asta-sekin unutildi. 1908-yilda arxeolog Vasiliy Vyatkin tomonidan qayta kashf etilgan uning qoldiqlari bugun butun dunyodan sayyohlarni jalb qiladi va asrlar davomida astronomiyani shakllantirgan ilmiy merosni eslatadi.

steps.q: What did Ulugh Beg and his team produce?

steps.q: In "Rediscovered in 1908, its remains now attract visitors", who or what was rediscovered?
steps.explain_uz: Participle clause'ning egasi asosiy gapning egasi bilan bir xil: **its remains** were rediscovered.

steps.body_uz:
Ikki gapning **egasi bir xil** bo'lsa, bittasini qisqartirib, gapni ixcham va akademik qilish mumkin.
**1) -ing (faol, bir vaqtda yoki sabab)**: Ulugh Beg worked with a team. He compiled a catalogue. → **Working** with a team, he compiled a catalogue. · **Feeling** tired, I went to bed. (= Because I felt tired)
**2) V3 (majhul / passiv)**: The observatory was built in the 1420s. It was... → **Built** in the 1420s, the observatory was...
**3) Having + V3 (avval tugagan harakat)**: He had studied maths. Then he... → **Having studied** maths, he... · Majhul: **Having been** told the news, she cried.
**4) Qisqartirilgan aniqlovchi gap**: a catalogue **which lists** stars → a catalogue **listing** stars · cotton **which is grown** here → cotton **grown** here.
⚠️ **Dangling participle**: "Walking into the room, the lights went off" — xato! Chiroqlar xonaga kirmaydi. To'g'ri: "Walking into the room, **I** noticed the lights were off."

steps.prompt: Write a short description of a historical place in Uzbekistan. Use at least three participle clauses (Built in..., Having..., -ing).
steps.example: Located in the heart of Samarkand, the Registan is one of the most famous squares in Central Asia. Surrounded by three magnificent madrasahs, it was once the centre of the city's commercial and religious life. The oldest of these buildings, constructed by Ulugh Beg in the 1410s, served as a university attracting scholars from across the Islamic world. Having been damaged by earthquakes over the centuries, the madrasahs were carefully restored in the twentieth century. Today, visitors walking across the square can admire the intricate blue tilework and the enormous domes. Having visited the Registan twice, I can honestly say that photographs do not capture its true scale and beauty.

steps.body_uz:
Ba'zan sabab va natija **turli zamonda** bo'ladi. Shunda ikki xil shart gapni aralashtiramiz.
**1) O'tmish sabab → hozirgi natija** (eng ko'p ishlatiladi):
**If + had + V3, ... would + V1 (now)** — If I **had studied** medicine, I **would be** a doctor now. · If she **hadn't missed** the flight, she **would be** here now.
**2) Hozirgi (doimiy) holat → o'tmishdagi natija**:
**If + Past Simple, ... would have + V3** — If I **weren't** so shy, I **would have spoken** to her yesterday. · If he **spoke** English, he **would have got** the job.
Taqqoslang: Third conditional — ikkalasi ham o'tmishda: If I had studied, I **would have passed**.
**Inversion** (rasmiy): **Had** I studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
Maslahat: "now", "today", "still" — 1-tur belgisi; "yesterday", "last year" — natija o'tmishda.

examples.en: If I had saved more money, I would be travelling now.
examples.uz: Ko'proq pul jamg'arganimda, hozir sayohat qilayotgan bo'lardim.

examples.en: If she weren't afraid of flying, she would have come to the wedding.
examples.uz: U uchishdan qo'rqmaganida, to'yga kelgan bo'lardi.

examples.uz: Toshkentga ko'chib kelmaganimizda, eng yaqin do'stimni tanimasdim.

examples.uz: O'qituvchimga quloq solganimda, hozirgacha ravon gapirardim.

lessons.title: It is believed that...
lessons.title_uz: Reporting passive: It is said that / is thought to have
lessons.goal_uz: Ma'lumotni manbaga havola qilib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan yetkazasiz: It is estimated that... / The city is thought to have been... — yangilik, Reading va Writing uchun akademik uslub.

Trade flourished along the Silk Road.
The village was abandoned in the 1970s.
The city lies at an altitude of 2,000 metres.
He allegedly stole the money.
It was a small mountain settlement.
The team carried out a survey of the area.

steps.title: Lost cities in the mountains
steps.text: Two medieval cities have been identified high in the mountains of eastern Uzbekistan, in an area once crossed by the Silk Road. Using drones and laser scanning technology, archaeologists carried out a detailed survey of the region, which revealed walls, towers and buildings hidden beneath the soil. The larger city, Tugunbulak, is estimated to have covered around 120 hectares and lies at an altitude of over 2,000 metres. It is thought to have flourished between the sixth and eleventh centuries, and the settlement is believed to have been an important centre of metalworking. Why the cities were eventually abandoned is still unclear. It has been suggested that changes in trade routes may have played a role, but researchers stress that more excavation is needed before firm conclusions can be drawn.
steps.uz: O'zbekiston sharqidagi tog'larda, bir paytlar Buyuk Ipak yo'li o'tgan hududda, ikkita o'rta asr shahri aniqlandi. Dron va lazer skanerlash texnologiyasidan foydalanib, arxeologlar hududni batafsil o'rganishdi va bu tuproq ostida yashiringan devorlar, minoralar va binolarni ko'rsatib berdi. Kattaroq shahar — Tugunbuloq — taxminan 120 gektarni egallagan deb hisoblanadi va dengiz sathidan 2000 metrdan baland joyda joylashgan. U VI–XI asrlarda gullab-yashnagan deb o'ylanadi va bu manzilgoh metallga ishlov berishning muhim markazi bo'lgan deb taxmin qilinadi. Shaharlar nega oxir-oqibat tashlab ketilgani hali ham noma'lum. Savdo yo'llaridagi o'zgarishlar rol o'ynagan bo'lishi mumkin, degan fikr aytilgan, ammo tadqiqotchilar qat'iy xulosa chiqarishdan oldin ko'proq qazish ishlari kerakligini ta'kidlashadi.

steps.q: Why does the writer use phrases like "is thought to" and "is believed to"?
options: Because the facts are completely certain
To show that the information comes from researchers and is not 100% certain
steps.explain_uz: Reporting passive — ma'lumotni **manbaga havola qilib** va **ehtiyotkorlik bilan** berish usuli.

steps.body_uz:
Kim aytgani muhim bo'lmasa yoki ma'lumot aniq bo'lmasa, **say, think, believe, know, report, estimate, expect, consider, claim** fe'llari passivda ishlatiladi.
**1) It + is + V3 + that ...**: **It is believed that** the city was abandoned. · **It is estimated that** 2 million people visit each year.
**2) Ega + is + V3 + to + infinitiv** (hozirgi/kelasi): Tugunbulak **is said to be** the largest site. · Prices **are expected to rise**.
**3) Ega + is + V3 + to have + V3** (o'tmish): The city **is thought to have flourished** in the 9th century. · He **is reported to have left** the country.
Davomli: She **is believed to be living** in London.
Maslahat: Writing Task 2'da "Everybody knows..." o'rniga **"It is widely believed that..."** — akademik va ehtiyotkor.

steps.prompt_uz: Qisqa yangilik maqolasi yozing (100+ so'z): shaharingizda topilgan qadimiy buyum yoki yangi kashfiyot haqida (o'ylab topishingiz mumkin). Kamida to'rtta reporting passive ishlating: It is believed that..., is thought to have..., It is estimated that...
steps.prompt: Write a short news report about an (imaginary) discovery in your city. Use at least four reporting passive structures.
steps.example: Workers building a new metro station in central Tashkent have discovered the remains of an ancient house. The building is thought to date from the tenth century, and it is believed to have belonged to a wealthy merchant. Several ceramic bowls and a number of coins were found inside, some of which are said to have come from as far away as China. It is estimated that the house was occupied for around two hundred years before being abandoned. Construction work has been stopped, and archaeologists are expected to spend at least six months examining the site. It is hoped that the most important objects will eventually be displayed in the city's history museum.
